check_results.details: Types passed and the final selected build produced proof 97e1c039d129/f5e6c30f3138. The focused PEI browser journey first passed 2/2 on canonical 390x844 Chromium and WebKit with zero retries, then passed again as part of the current 73-pass canonical phone phase after restart/finality hardening. It covers two origins, earn, helper reload, spend, both returns, admission, reload before Daily start and V10 R5 volcanic play. Logs .cache/wp022d-browser-pei-2.log, .cache/wp022e-selector-checks-3.log and .cache/wp022e-selector-browser.log.

Primary reviewed strict URL carriers and request HMACs, same-wallet enforcement, explicit helper facts, provider error handling, server-side finality, sessionStorage transaction resume, return parsing, admission persistence and the unchanged Practice path.

reviews.details: The synthetic two-origin browser journey is complete. Test execution was delegated only to /root/verification.

Real Nimiq Pay cross-origin navigation and wallet transfer were deferred to Phone Gate B.
